newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-STEVE WAUGH GIVEN SUSPENDED FINE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-STEVE WAUGH GIVEN SUSPENDED FINE.

text.p: Australian vice-captain Steve Waugh was reprimanded and given a suspended fine of 30 percent of his match fee for three months for challenging an umpire's ruling in a Singer World Series match on Friday.
Waugh, named man-of-the-match after Australia beat India by three wickets in the four-team limited overs tournament, challenged Sri Lankan umpire B.C.Cooray over his ruling on wide deliveries.
Waugh was reported by Cooray for violating International Cricket Council (ICC) code of conduct rules.
After a full inquiry conducted by ICC match referee John Reid, Waugh was punished for "dissent and bringing the game into disrepute".
Australia's victory secured their place in Saturday's final against Sri Lanka.
